profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ CIASC |  C# & Java Specialist | Oracle SQL | MSc in Computer Science
profile.summary:
Software development, with knowledge in C#, Java, Oracle SQL, and agile methods.

Developed data synchronization and event processing projects, through web services, using C# and created applications used by taxpayers, using C# and Oracle for the Santa Catarina state finance secretariat.

Developed news portal, online word processing, and network management systems using Java, Javascript, NoSQL, and Mysql databases and created a team management system using Ruby.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
CIASC is a public company in Santa Catarina that operates in the development of IT and automation solutions for state administration. 

In the tax system of the Santa Catarina State Department of Finance:

- Developed web projects to edit, close, and create taxpayer companies using C#, ASP, and Oracle. The new applications impact tens of thousands of users.

- Developed migrations to C# of state tax business rules from PLSQL/Oracle legacy systems, updating the rules with current Santa Catarina state tax laws. The improvements reduced tax collection errors, affecting thousands of taxpayers.

- Developed web projects to manage and monitor pending issues to complete taxpayer processes.

- Developed a job to automatically analyze and regularize the processes of closing, opening, and editing companies. This brought agility to processes and reduced appointments for taxpayers and accountants.

- Developed a system to identify and correct companies that do not fit into lower-cost tax payment categories. This generated an increase in state revenue.

- Developed a system for tax auditors in Santa Catarina state to inspect gas stations and similar companies, generating better control over fraud and money laundering.

- Developed for the Santa Catarina State Department of Finance, a cadastral integration project between government entities, involving the Special Department of Federal Revenue of Brazil, Brazil Boards of Trade, and state finance departments of Brazil, in a national project called REDESIM, using Webservices, XML, C#, and Oracle. The creation, editing, closing, reactivation, and suspension of companies as well as the change in the type of tax were automated, initiated by events at the Brazilian Federal Revenue Service and the Santa Catarina Board of Trade or by the action of a company accountant via a national web portal. This brought agility to processes and customer service workers were reallocated to other areas.

positions.title: Software Engineer at Oncast Technologies
positions.description:
OnCast is an outsourcing company specializing in mentoring agile and Lean methodologies.

- Developed a news portal using Java, Cassandra, and Mysql.

- Developed an investigative intelligence report application using Java and Javascript.

- Developed SatcelWeb Parameters (SATCEL) for Suntech in network management using Java, DWR, and iBatis.

- Developed, from scratch, a team management system using Ruby on Rails.

- Implemented automated tests throughout development using tools like JUnit.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Agriness is a Brazilian company that develops solutions for agribusiness.

- Developed a human resources system using GWT and Java.
